final: WITH g AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_ratio FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall FROM g WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT g.AlbumId, g.avg_price, g.avg_ratio, g.avg_ratio - o.overall AS diff FROM g JOIN o ON o.overall IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (g.avg_ratio - o.overall) IS NULL, (g.avg_ratio - o.overall) DESC LIMIT 10
